title: HexaBlock Suite class model (D7)
sourceOfTruth: This file. The class-diagram*.puml views and the class reference of docs/domain-model.md are generated from it.

conventions.readOnly: Every attribute is {readOnly} unless readOnly is false. A public readOnly attribute is a value outside code may read (screen, mapper, test); there are no setters.
conventions.nullable: A type ending in ? is optional (multiplicity 0..1).
conventions.pendingTrace: A trace ending in † is decided but not yet in docs/game-rules.md or docs/requirements.md on main.
conventions.valueObjectEquality: Every value object compares by value and validates its invariant when created.

classes.name: Coordinate
classes.invariant: At least one component. The topology that receives it checks the length and the range (ITopology.isValid).
classes.summary: A cell position as a list of integers. Only the topology and the board renderer of the same topology interpret the numbers; the layer-3 mappers copy them to and from JSON without interpreting them; rules ask the topology.

classes.name: ITopology
classes.summary: The grid geometry: neighbors, axes, directions, rotation and the fixed order of cells. The board, the rules and the shapes depend on it, never on hexagons. Its id is the name a level file gives in board.topology.

classes.name: HexTopology
classes.summary: Hexagonal topology on axial coordinates [q, r]. Rotation by one step maps [q, r] to [-r, q + r]. Fixed order: r ascending, then q ascending. Its id is "hex". Adapted from Red Blob Games, "Hexagonal Grids" (Amit Patel), https://www.redblobgames.com/grids/hexagons/. One instance, registered in the TopologyRegistry by the composition root.

classes.name: TopologyId
classes.summary: The name of a topology as the level format writes it in board.topology ("hex").

classes.name: TopologyRegistry
classes.summary: The topologies the app knows, keyed by id. The composition root registers them; the level builders resolve the topology a level declares here. It implements the "factory" through which ADR-0004 resolves the topology of a level: a lookup by id of the instances the composition root registered, because a topology has no per-level state to build. A level that names a topology not registered is refused. One instance, injected.

classes.name: Direction
classes.invariant: index >= 0 (the topology that issues it checks the upper bound).
classes.summary: One of the directions of a topology (6 in hex). Slides (Merge) and swipes use it.

classes.name: Axis
classes.invariant: index >= 0 (the topology that issues it checks the upper bound).
classes.summary: One of the axes along which the topology draws straight rows (3 in hex).

classes.name: RotationSteps
classes.summary: A rotation as a count of the topology's rotation steps (60° each in hex). Fit counts one move per step.

classes.name: Radius
classes.summary: The radius of a regular board (4 for Lines, 2 for Sort and Merge).

classes.name: Shape
classes.invariant: At least one cell, all valid in the topology, connected through neighbors.
classes.summary: A set of cells relative to the origin: a piece outline. It moves and rotates through its topology.

classes.name: CellLine
classes.summary: A maximal straight row of board cells along one axis.

classes.name: Board
classes.invariant: Every coordinate is valid in the topology; contents only on board coordinates.
classes.summary: The immutable board: a set of coordinates of one topology and the content of the occupied ones. Every change returns a new board. HexBoard<TCell> of the assignment is Board<TCell> with a HexTopology. TCell has no bound: the board only stores and returns contents. Its constructor is library-private: BoardBuilder calls it, and the with… operations return boards that keep the invariant. Strategy context of ITopology.

classes.name: BoardBuilder
classes.summary: Builds a valid Board step by step: a regular shape or an arbitrary set of cells (a Fit figure), then initial contents.

classes.name: DomainError
classes.summary: Base of the errors a domain object raises when asked to break an invariant.

classes.name: InvalidValueError
classes.summary: A value object refused its input (for example Radius(-1)).

classes.name: InvalidBoardError
classes.summary: BoardBuilder refused a board (invalid coordinate, content outside the board).

classes.name: InvalidLevelError
classes.summary: A level builder refused a level; check names the failed check of the level format (for example F1, S2, L1), or board.topology when the level names a topology that is not registered.

classes.name: IGameRules
classes.summary: The rules of one variant: the steps of the game cycle that vary. GameEngine delegates each step to it.

classes.name: GameEngine
classes.summary: The generic engine. Runs the cycle for every move: phase accepts it → validate → apply → resolve → evaluate → phase transition → notify listeners with one StateChange that names its cause. Concrete; it never asks which variant it runs. restore replaces the state for the undo history: the state, not the engine, is the Memento originator. Scoring happens inside the rules' resolve.

classes.name: IRestorable
classes.summary: Something whose current state can be replaced by a restored one. The undo history only needs this of the engine (ISP).

classes.name: MoveValidation
classes.invariant: reason is present exactly when the move is rejected.
classes.summary: The answer of validate: accepted, or rejected with a reason.

classes.name: RejectionReason
classes.invariant: code is a non-empty key in kebab case, prefixed by the game id or "engine".
classes.summary: Why a move was refused, as a translation key the screen shows (FR-10). Nothing branches on it.

classes.name: Resolution
classes.summary: What resolve returns: the settled state and the variant events it produced (lines cleared, cascades, merges).

classes.name: GameEnd
classes.summary: The verdict of evaluate after each move.

classes.name: GameOutcome
classes.summary: What a finished game measured, for its progress model. Each variant fills only what it has: Lines and Merge a score; Fit the moves and (from the timer capability) the time; Sort score and moves. What a level demands (par, thresholds) lives in the progress model, not here.

classes.name: IGameFactory
classes.summary: Creates the family of objects of one variant: board, rules, initial state, capabilities and progress model. One instance per game, configured through its constructor (level, seed, clock).

classes.name: GameAssembler
classes.summary: Puts a game together from a factory: creates board, rules and state, builds the engine, then asks the factory for the capabilities that observe it and for the progress model. Never names a variant.

classes.name: PreparedGame
classes.summary: A ready game: the engine, the optional capabilities of its variant and the progress model of this game (with its level's par or thresholds).

classes.name: IMergeable
classes.summary: A cell content that can merge with an equal one. T is the content type itself (TileValue implements IMergeable<TileValue>); the bound that enforces it sits on the consumer, SlideMergeRule.

classes.name: SlideMergeRule

typeParameters.name: TCell
typeParameters.boundReason: The rule merges two colliding cells; it can only ask canMergeWith and mergedWith of a content that implements IMergeable.

classes.summary: Slides every content of a board to the edge in one direction and merges equal neighbors once per move. Reusable by any variant whose cells merge.

classes.name: SlideResult
classes.invariant: merged is empty when changed is false.
classes.summary: The board after a slide, the values produced by its merges (in fixed order) and whether anything moved.

classes.name: LineClearRule
classes.summary: Finds the full rows of a board along every axis and empties them in one step; a cell on two full rows is cleared once. TCell has no bound: the rule only asks whether a cell is empty.

classes.name: LineClear
classes.invariant: clearedCells is the union of the cells of lines.
classes.summary: The board after clearing, the rows cleared and the cells emptied.

classes.name: GamePhase
classes.summary: The phase of a game (State pattern). Each phase says whether it accepts moves and which phase follows a pause, a resume or an end.

classes.name: PlayingPhase
classes.summary: Accepts moves. pause → Paused; ended(won) → Won; ended(lost) → Lost; ended(ongoing) → itself.

classes.name: PausedPhase
classes.summary: Accepts no moves; only resume (→ Playing). Fit's timer stops; the screen hides the board when the game has a timer.

classes.name: WonPhase
classes.summary: Terminal: the player won (Fit, Sort). Accepts nothing.

classes.name: LostPhase
classes.summary: Terminal: the game is over without a win (Sort defeat; the end of the endless games Lines and Merge, whose result is the score).

classes.name: PhaseKind
classes.summary: The name of a phase, for events, views and tests.

classes.name: GameEvent
classes.summary: Something that happened in the engine, sent to the listeners inside the StateChange of each move. Immutable. Audio and the screen react to kind and cells (the cells it affects, in order); nobody checks the class of an event.

classes.name: EventKind
classes.summary: The key of an event (for example "lines-cleared"). The audio map and the presenters map it to a sound or an animation.

classes.name: MoveApplied
classes.summary: A move passed validation and was applied.

classes.name: MoveRejected
classes.summary: A move failed validation; the state did not change.

classes.name: PhaseChanged
classes.summary: The phase changed (pause, resume, end).

classes.name: GameWon
classes.summary: The game ended with a win.

classes.name: GameLost
classes.summary: The game ended without a win.

classes.name: StateRestored
classes.summary: Undo or redo replaced the state (cause restored).

classes.name: IStateListener
classes.summary: Receives each change of a game: the state before and after, its cause, its events and the phase. The only listener interface (undo history, stopwatch, session adapter).

classes.name: StateChange
classes.summary: One notification: the state before and after, why it changed, the events and the phase after. Listeners decide on cause and phase, never on the class of an event.

classes.name: ChangeCause
classes.summary: Why the engine notified: a move applied or rejected, a restore (undo, redo), a pause or a resume. The history keeps a snapshot only on moveApplied; the stopwatch starts, pauses and resumes on it.

classes.name: IUndoable
classes.summary: Optional capability: undo the last move.

classes.name: IRedoable
classes.summary: Optional capability: redo an undone move.

classes.name: ITimed
classes.summary: Optional capability: the game measures its time.

classes.name: IRandomSeeded
classes.summary: Optional capability: the game was started from a seed, so it can be replayed.

classes.name: CapabilitySet
classes.invariant: redo is present only if undo is present.
classes.summary: The optional capabilities of one game, as typed optional fields. Use cases and the screen read the fields; nobody checks the type of the rules or the variant.

classes.name: SeedRecord
classes.summary: The seeded capability of a game: the seed it started from.

classes.name: ISnapshotable
classes.summary: A state that exports what undo must bring back and rebuilds itself from it. TSelf is the state type itself, so restoredFrom returns FitState or MergeState without a cast; the bound that enforces it sits on the consumer, SnapshotHistory. What the snapshot leaves out (Fit's move count) is kept from the current state.

classes.name: SnapshotHistory

typeParameters.name: TState
typeParameters.boundReason: The history calls toSnapshot on the state before each move and restoredFrom on the current state; both need ISnapshotable.

classes.summary: Caretaker. Listens to state changes and refreshes latest on every one, restores included. When the cause is moveApplied it also keeps before.toSnapshot(), within its capacity. undo restores latest.restoredFrom(the last snapshot) into the engine. Never reads a snapshot.

classes.name: RedoableSnapshotHistory

typeParameters.name: TState
typeParameters.boundReason: Same bound as SnapshotHistory, which it extends.

classes.summary: A history that also redoes: undo pushes the snapshot of the state before the undo onto the future stack; redo restores it; a change with cause moveApplied clears the future.

classes.name: HistoryCapacity
classes.summary: How many snapshots a history keeps: unlimited (Fit) or a number of steps (Merge: 1).

classes.name: IRandomSource
classes.summary: An immutable pseudo-random generator. Each draw returns the value and the next source, so a state that holds a source can be saved and replayed.

classes.name: Mulberry32
classes.summary: Mulberry32 generator by Tommy Ettinger (2017, public domain CC0), https://gist.github.com/tommyettinger/46a874533244883189143505d203312c. 32-bit state; increment 0x6D2B79F5. Every operation is masked to 32 bits, because Dart integers are 64-bit. Not equidistributed (about a third of the 32-bit values never appear), which does not matter for a game. nextBelow rejects the biased tail.

classes.name: IRandomSourceFactory
classes.summary: Creates random sources. Factories of variants receive it, so tests can inject a fake.

classes.name: Mulberry32Factory
classes.summary: Creates Mulberry32 sources. One instance, injected by the composition root.

classes.name: RandomDraw
classes.summary: A drawn value and the source to draw the next one from.

classes.name: Seed
classes.summary: The seed of a game.

classes.name: GeneratorState
classes.summary: The internal state of a generator, saved with the game and in Merge's undo snapshot.

classes.name: IPieceSource
classes.summary: Where pieces come from: a seeded random source (Lines tray, Sort tray, Merge spawns) or a fixed list (Fit). Immutable. Each implementation narrows the return type of next to itself (a covariant override in Dart), so a state that holds a SeededPieceSource keeps it typed, and can save its generator state, without a cast.

classes.name: PieceDraw

typeParameters.name: TSource
typeParameters.boundReason: rest must be a source of the same pieces; the bound lets a concrete source return itself as rest (SeededPieceSource<LinesPiece>) while the interface promises only IPieceSource<TPiece>.

classes.summary: A piece and the source that gives the following ones.

classes.name: IPieceRecipe
classes.summary: How a variant turns random numbers into one piece (a catalog entry, a stack, a spawned tile).

classes.name: SeededPieceSource
classes.summary: A piece source driven by a random source and a recipe. Same seed and recipe give the same pieces.

classes.name: FixedPieceSource
classes.summary: A piece source over a fixed list, delivered in order. Hexa Fit's factory builds one from the level's pieces and hands them all out at the start with drawAll.

classes.name: Clock
classes.summary: Output port declared in the domain: the current time. SystemClock implements it; tests use a fake.

classes.name: GameStopwatch
classes.summary: Fit's timer. Reads only the cause and the phase of each change: starts on the first moveApplied, pauses on paused, resumes on resumed, stops when the phase is over; reports whole seconds, truncated. Generic only because IStateListener is; it never reads the state.

classes.name: ElapsedTime
classes.summary: A playing time in whole seconds.

classes.name: IScoringPolicy
classes.summary: The points one move earns, from the state before and after it. The rules call it inside resolve. Fit has none (it has no points).

classes.name: IProgressModel
classes.summary: How a game turns its outcome into a result and compares it with the saved best. The variant's factory creates it with what the level demands (par, thresholds). Not generic: it reads only GameOutcome.

classes.name: GameResult
classes.summary: The result of one game as it is saved and ranked: a score (Lines, Merge, Sort) or stars, moves and time (Fit, Sort).

classes.name: HighScoreProgress
classes.summary: Progress of the endless games (Lines, Merge): the result is the score; a result is better when its score is higher (RANK-1: the earlier date keeps a tie).

classes.name: Score
classes.summary: Points.

classes.name: StarCount
classes.summary: Stars of a won level.

classes.name: MoveCount
classes.summary: Moves made. Only grows (FIT-4).

classes.name: ResultDate
classes.summary: When a result was achieved, in UTC, from the Clock port.

classes.name: GoalCount
classes.summary: Goals of a Sort level (blocks removed).

classes.name: GameId
classes.invariant: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; non-empty.
classes.summary: The identifier of a variant (for example "hexa-lines"). Mandatory dimension of progress, levels and leaderboards.

classes.name: LevelId
classes.summary: The identifier of a level: "<gameId>-NNN".

classes.name: LevelNumber
classes.summary: The position of a level in its game.

classes.name: LevelVersion
classes.summary: The version of a level definition; a download replaces a lower version.

classes.name: Difficulty
classes.summary: The difficulty of a level.

classes.name: LevelHeader
classes.invariant: id starts with gameId and ends with number (check L1).
classes.summary: What every level shares, whatever its game.

classes.name: LevelCatalog
classes.invariant: one header per level id; all of the same game.
classes.summary: The levels of one game: bundled ones merged with downloaded ones (the higher version wins), in number order.

classes.name: LevelAccess
classes.summary: A level as the level select shows it: unlocked or locked, completed or not.

classes.name: LevelPar
classes.summary: The move par and time par of a Fit level.

classes.name: MoveThresholds
classes.summary: The two move thresholds of a Sort level.

classes.name: ColorId
classes.invariant: key is a non-empty lowercase word.
classes.summary: A color of the palette shared by Lines pieces and Sort tiles (for example "red"). Painters map it to a screen color.

classes.name: HexaLinesEngine
classes.summary: Dart typedef: the generic engine bound to Hexa Lines. Adds no code.

classes.name: HexaLinesFactory
classes.summary: Creates the Hexa Lines family: a radius-4 board, the rules with their scoring and line clearing, the first tray from the seed, the seeded capability and the high-score progress model.

classes.name: LinesState
classes.summary: The whole state of a Hexa Lines game. Immutable; each transition returns a new one and keeps its own consistency (the placed cells are free; the tray slot held a piece). Saved whole for FR-16, generator included.

classes.name: LinesMove
classes.summary: Place the piece of one tray slot with its origin at a cell.

classes.name: Tray
classes.invariant: exactly 3 slots; each holds a piece or nothing.
classes.summary: The three slots of offered pieces. A taken slot stays empty until the tray is empty and refills.

classes.name: TrayRefill
classes.summary: A refilled tray and the piece source after drawing its three pieces.

classes.name: TraySlot
classes.summary: One of the three tray positions.

classes.name: LinesPiece
classes.summary: A poly-hex of 1 to 5 cells with its color. It never rotates.

classes.name: PieceCatalog
classes.invariant: at least one entry; every entry has 1 to 5 cells.
classes.summary: The fixed catalog of Hexa Lines pieces, loaded from configuration (no rotation: each orientation is its own entry).

classes.name: CatalogRecipe
classes.summary: Draws one catalog entry uniformly.

classes.name: HexaLinesRules
classes.summary: Orchestrates; the state holds the logic. validate: state.canPlace(slot, at). apply: state.withPiecePlaced. resolve: LineClearRule finds the full rows, state.withLinesCleared empties them and extends or breaks the streak, the scoring policy gives the points from the states before and after, state.withPointsAdded adds them, state.withTrayRefilled refills an empty tray. evaluate: lost when not state.anyPieceFits(). Strategy context of IScoringPolicy.

classes.name: Streak
classes.summary: Consecutive moves that cleared at least one line.

classes.name: ClearReport
classes.summary: What the last move did: cells placed and lines cleared. The scoring policy reads it.

classes.name: LinesScoringPolicy
classes.summary: Points of one move: cells placed + 10 × L × L × streak, where L is the lines cleared by the move.

classes.name: LinesCleared
classes.summary: One or more lines were cleared; cells are the cleared cells.

classes.name: TrayRefilled
classes.summary: The tray was empty and got three new pieces; cells is empty.

classes.name: HexaFitEngine
classes.summary: Dart typedef: the generic engine bound to Hexa Fit. Adds no code.

classes.name: HexaFitFactory
classes.summary: Creates the Hexa Fit family from one level: the figure as the board, in the topology the level declares, the rules, the state with every piece free (a FixedPieceSource over the level's pieces, taken whole with drawAll), the capabilities undo + redo (unlimited history) and timer (stopwatch on the Clock port), and the progress model with the level's par.

classes.name: FitLevel
classes.invariant: figure area = total area of the pieces (F3, FR-40); at least one piece; piece ids unique.
classes.summary: A Hexa Fit level: its identity is header.id, which stays the same across versions. It holds the topology its file declares. Built only by FitLevelBuilder.

classes.name: Figure
classes.invariant: connected through neighbors and without interior holes, checked on the unbounded grid (FIT-1).
classes.summary: The closed figure to cover: an arbitrary set of cells.

classes.name: FitPiece
classes.summary: A piece of a level. Two equal shapes are two pieces with their own identity (FIT-2), which is why it is an entity. FitLevel keeps the ids unique.

classes.name: PieceId
classes.summary: The identity of a piece in its level; the content of a covered board cell.

classes.name: FitState
classes.invariant: a piece is either placed (one placement) or free; the board holds exactly the cells of the placed pieces.
classes.summary: The state of a Hexa Fit game: board covered by piece ids, placements, orientations of the pieces, and the move count. Each transition returns a new state and adds its moves (1, or the rotation steps).

classes.name: FitSnapshot
classes.summary: Memento of Hexa Fit: board, placements and orientations. No move count and no clock: undo and redo never change them (FIT-4). Only FitState reads it.

classes.name: PiecePlacement
classes.summary: Where a placed piece sits. Its rotation lives only in FitState.orientations.

classes.name: FitMove
classes.summary: The closed set of Hexa Fit moves (Dart sealed class): place, remove, rotate.

classes.name: PlaceFitPiece
classes.summary: Place a free piece, in its current orientation, with its origin at a cell.

classes.name: RemoveFitPiece
classes.summary: Take a placed piece off the figure.

classes.name: RotateFitPiece
classes.summary: Turn a free piece by some rotation steps (each step counts one move).

classes.name: HexaFitRules
classes.summary: Orchestrates; the state holds the logic. validate: place only when state.canPlace; remove only a placed piece; rotate only a free piece (FIT-7: a placed piece is lifted, rotated and placed again). apply: state.withPlaced, withLifted or withRotated. resolve: nothing to settle. evaluate: won when state.isCovered(); never lost (FR-43).

classes.name: FitLevelBuilder
classes.summary: Builds a valid FitLevel and refuses an invalid one with InvalidLevelError: the topology the level declares must be registered (board.topology), then the Hexa Fit checks of the level format F1–F4 and the common checks (L1, L2), including FIT-1, and it gives each piece a unique id. F5 checks the optional solution, which the game never reads: the API validator and a test over the bundled levels check it, not the builder. It builds the pieces' shapes in the resolved topology.

classes.name: FitLevelProgress
classes.summary: Hexa Fit progress for one level: stars = 1 + (moves <= move par) + (time <= time par); better by stars, then fewer moves, then less time (RANK-1). The factory creates it with the level's par.

classes.name: HexaSortEngine
classes.summary: Dart typedef: the generic engine bound to Hexa Sort. Adds no code.

classes.name: HexaSortFactory
classes.summary: Creates the Hexa Sort family from one level: a regular board of the level's radius (2 in the bundled levels) in the topology the level declares, the rules with goal, cascade and scoring, the first stack from the level's seed, the seeded capability, and the progress model with the level's thresholds. No undo (FR-56).

classes.name: SortLevel
classes.summary: A Hexa Sort level: its identity is header.id. It holds the topology its file declares. Built only by SortLevelBuilder. The seed lives in the level, so every player gets the same trays.

classes.name: TrayParams
classes.invariant: at least 2 colors, no color repeated (level format).
classes.summary: What the tray generator may draw in one level: the seed, the colors in play and the size range of a stack.

classes.name: StackSizeRange
classes.invariant: 1 <= min <= max <= 9 (S1 and the level format).
classes.summary: The minimum and maximum tiles of a drawn stack. At most 9, so a drawn stack never arrives already holding a block of 10 to remove.

classes.name: SortLevelBuilder
classes.summary: Builds a valid SortLevel and refuses an invalid one with InvalidLevelError: the topology the level declares must be registered (board.topology), then the Hexa Sort checks of the level format (S1, S2) and the common checks (L1, L2).

classes.name: ColorStack
classes.summary: A stack of colored tiles, bottom to top; the content of a Sort cell.

classes.name: TopBlock
classes.summary: The contiguous run of same-color tiles at the top of a stack: the unit of transfer.

classes.name: SortState
classes.summary: The state of a Hexa Sort game: board of stacks, the offered stack, the tray source, goals, moves and score. Each transition returns a new state; goals, moves and score only grow because the transitions only add.

classes.name: SortMove
classes.summary: Place the offered stack on an empty cell.

classes.name: SortTurn
classes.summary: What the last cascade removed; the scoring policy reads it.

classes.name: HexaSortRules
classes.summary: Orchestrates; the state holds the logic. validate: the cell is on the board and empty. apply: state.withStackPlaced(at) puts the offered stack there, counts the move and draws the next stack. resolve: CascadeResolver runs the cascade from the placed cell, state.withCascade applies it and counts the goals, the scoring policy gives the points, state.withPointsAdded adds them. evaluate: won when state.reaches(goal), else lost when not state.hasEmptyCell() (SORT-5). Strategy context of IScoringPolicy.

classes.name: CascadeResolver
classes.summary: The cascade of SORT-1..4: top blocks of the same color move toward the stack with more of that color (tie: SORT-2), in the order of SORT-3, until nothing moves; a block of 10 or more is removed (SORT-4).

classes.name: CascadeResult
classes.summary: The board after the cascade, the blocks removed and the events in the order of SORT-3.

classes.name: StackRecipe
classes.summary: Draws one stack: a size uniform in the level's range, and each tile's color uniform among the level's colors, bottom tile first, every draw from the level's seed (SORT-8).

classes.name: SortScoringPolicy
classes.summary: 10 points per tile removed in the move.

classes.name: SortLevelProgress
classes.summary: Hexa Sort progress for one level: stars = 1 + thresholds met (SORT-7); better by stars, then fewer moves (RANK-1). The factory creates it with the level's thresholds.

classes.name: StackTransferred
classes.summary: A top block moved from one stack to a neighbor; cells are [from, to].

classes.name: BlockRemoved
classes.summary: A block of 10 or more tiles left the board and counted one goal; cells are [at].

classes.name: HexaMergeEngine
classes.summary: Dart typedef: the generic engine bound to Hexa Merge. Adds no code.

classes.name: HexaMergeFactory
classes.summary: Creates the Hexa Merge family: a radius-2 board, the rules with the reusable SlideMergeRule<TileValue>, a state with two spawned tiles, and the capabilities undo (one step, no redo) and seeded, and the high-score progress model.

classes.name: TileValue
classes.invariant: value is a power of 2 and >= 2.
classes.summary: A numeric tile: a power of 2. Merges with an equal tile into its double.

classes.name: MergeState
classes.summary: The state of a Hexa Merge game. Saved whole for FR-16, generator included. afterSlide sets targetReached when a merged value reaches the target; undoing that move restores targetReached = false, so the notice can show again.

classes.name: MergeSnapshot
classes.summary: Memento of Hexa Merge: board, score, the tile source with its generator state, and whether the target was reached. Undo brings back the same next tile (MERGE-4). Only MergeState reads it.

classes.name: MergeMove
classes.summary: Swipe in one of the topology's directions.

classes.name: MergeTurn
classes.summary: What the last move did: the values produced by merges and the spawned tile.

classes.name: HexaMergeRules
classes.summary: Orchestrates; the state holds the logic. validate: refuse a swipe that changes nothing (it never reaches the history). apply: SlideMergeRule slides and merges, state.afterSlide keeps the result, the scoring policy gives the points, state.withPointsAdded adds them. resolve: state.withSpawn adds one tile in an empty cell; TargetReached is raised the first time the target appears. evaluate: lost when SlideMergeRule.canSlide is false (MERGE-1). The game starts with two tiles (MERGE-3). Strategy context of IScoringPolicy.

classes.name: TileSpawn
classes.summary: A tile to add after a move: its value and the slot that picks the cell.

classes.name: SpawnSlot
classes.summary: A raw draw that picks one of the empty cells in fixed order (draw modulo the number of empty cells; the bias, below 1 in 10^8 for 19 cells, does not matter in a game).

classes.name: SpawnOdds
classes.summary: The chance that a spawned tile is a 4 instead of a 2, per hundred.

classes.name: TileSpawnRecipe
classes.summary: Draws one TileSpawn: a value from the odds and a raw slot.

classes.name: MergeScoringPolicy
classes.summary: Points of one move: the sum of the merged values; spawned tiles add nothing.

classes.name: TilesMerged
classes.summary: One or more merges happened; cells are the cells of the merged tiles.

classes.name: TileSpawned
classes.summary: A new tile appeared; cells are [at].

classes.name: TargetReached
classes.summary: The target tile appeared for the first time in this game: a notice; play continues. cells are [the target tile].

classes.name: StartGameUseCase
classes.summary: Start a game of any variant, by game id, level and seed.

classes.name: ApplyMoveUseCase
classes.summary: Send one player intent to the active game.

classes.name: UndoMoveUseCase
classes.summary: Undo the last move when the active game offers undo; answers whether it did.

classes.name: RedoMoveUseCase
classes.summary: Redo an undone move when the active game offers redo.

classes.name: PauseGameUseCase
classes.summary: Pause the active game (app sent to the background, pause button).

classes.name: ResumeGameUseCase
classes.summary: Resume the active game.

classes.name: SaveProgressUseCase
classes.summary: Turn a finished game into a result with the session's own progress model and keep it when it beats the saved best.

classes.name: GetProgressUseCase
classes.summary: Read the saved best results of one game.

classes.name: ListLevelsUseCase
classes.summary: List the levels of a level-based game with their lock and completion.

classes.name: DownloadLevelsUseCase
classes.summary: Fetch new or changed level definitions and store them.

classes.name: SaveGameUseCase
classes.summary: Save the game in progress when its variant supports it.

classes.name: ResumeSavedGameUseCase
classes.summary: Resume a saved game of one variant, if there is one.

classes.name: SyncProgressUseCase
classes.summary: Send the unsynced results to the backend and bring the remote ones.

classes.name: GetLeaderboardUseCase
classes.summary: Read the global leaderboard of a game or a level.

classes.name: RegisterUseCase
classes.summary: Create an account.

classes.name: SignInUseCase
classes.summary: Sign in.

classes.name: SignOutUseCase
classes.summary: Sign out.

classes.name: GetPreferencesUseCase
classes.summary: Read sound and language preferences.

classes.name: UpdatePreferencesUseCase
classes.summary: Change sound and language preferences and apply them.

classes.name: ActiveSession
classes.summary: Holds the game being played, shared by the services that act on it. One instance, injected.

classes.name: GameSessionService
classes.summary: Implements the game use cases for every variant: finds the variant module by game id, starts its session, forwards intents, and reaches undo, redo and pause through the session's CapabilitySet. No rule and no variant name in it.

classes.name: ProgressService
classes.summary: Asks the session's progress model for the result of its outcome and whether it beats the saved best; saves it with the date from Clock. Strategy context of IProgressModel; it never names a variant.

classes.name: LevelCatalogService
classes.summary: Lists the levels of a game with their access, and downloads new or changed definitions.

classes.name: SavedGameService
classes.summary: Saves the active game through its saving capability and resumes a saved one through the variant's resumable module.

classes.name: SyncService
classes.summary: When the player is signed in, pushes unsynced results and pulls remote ones; does nothing offline.

classes.name: LeaderboardService
classes.summary: Reads a leaderboard from the backend.

classes.name: AccountService
classes.summary: Registers, signs in and signs out; keeps the session in the session store.

classes.name: PreferencesService
classes.summary: Reads and changes preferences, and applies the sound ones to the audio output.

classes.name: IProgressRepository
classes.summary: Local store of the best result per game and level.

classes.name: ILevelRepository
classes.summary: Bundled and downloaded level definitions.

classes.name: ISavedGameRepository
classes.summary: One saved game per variant.

classes.name: IPreferencesRepository
classes.summary: Stored preferences.

classes.name: ISessionStore
classes.summary: Secure storage of the signed-in session.

classes.name: IProgressGateway
classes.summary: Remote progress API.

classes.name: ILeaderboardGateway
classes.summary: Remote leaderboard API.

classes.name: IAccountGateway
classes.summary: Remote account API.

classes.name: ILevelGateway
classes.summary: Remote level API.

classes.name: ISeedSource
classes.summary: Seeds for new games of the seeded variants without a level seed (Lines, Merge).

classes.name: IAudioOutput
classes.summary: Sound effects and music.

classes.name: VariantModule
classes.summary: The extension contract of a variant, without type parameters. Each variant registers one; inside it wraps its typed engine in a PlayableSession. A fifth variant adds a module; no use case and no screen changes.

classes.name: IResumableVariant
classes.summary: Optional part of a module: resume a saved game (Lines, Merge).

classes.name: VariantRegistry
classes.summary: The registered modules, keyed by game id. The composition root registers them; nothing switches on the variant. One instance, injected.

classes.name: VariantTexts
classes.summary: Translation keys of a variant: its name and its rules summary.

classes.name: PlayableSession
classes.summary: A running game seen without its types: takes neutral intents, gives a neutral view, its capabilities, its progress model, its outcome (with the time, when it has a timer) and a stream of updates.

classes.name: ISaveableSession
classes.summary: Optional part of a session: export the whole game.

classes.name: StartGameRequest
classes.invariant: levelId belongs to gameId when present.
classes.summary: What the screen asks to start.

classes.name: SessionRequest
classes.summary: What a module receives to start a session: the seed is always resolved (from the request, the level or ISeedSource).

classes.name: PlayerIntent
classes.summary: What the player did on screen, independent of the variant (Dart sealed class). Each variant's translator turns it into its move, or ignores it.

classes.name: TapCell
classes.summary: Tap on a cell (Sort).

classes.name: DropPiece
classes.summary: Drop a tray piece on a cell (Lines, Fit).

classes.name: Swipe
classes.summary: Swipe in a direction (Merge).

classes.name: RotatePiece
classes.summary: Rotate a tray piece one step (Fit).

classes.name: LiftPiece
classes.summary: Lift a placed piece off a cell (Fit).

classes.name: PieceRef
classes.summary: A piece of the tray view, by position.

classes.name: SessionView
classes.summary: Everything the game screen draws, the same for every variant.

classes.name: BoardView
classes.invariant: no two cell views share a coordinate; each coordinate is valid in the topology.
classes.summary: The board to draw: its topology and one view per cell.

classes.name: CellView
classes.summary: One cell to draw: its fills bottom to top and an optional label (a tile value).

classes.name: ColorToken
classes.summary: A color the painter knows (a palette key, a tile value or a piece id).

classes.name: PieceView
classes.summary: A tray piece to draw.

classes.name: StatLine
classes.summary: A labeled value on the game screen (score, moves, goals, time).

classes.name: SessionUpdate
classes.summary: What a session sends after each change: the new view, one effect per event (for sound and animation) and the phase.

classes.name: SessionEffect
classes.summary: One event as the screen and the audio see it: its kind and the cells it affects, in order. The session adapter builds it from any event without asking its class.

classes.name: SavedGame
classes.summary: A game in progress exported by its variant: the game id and an opaque payload only that variant's codec reads.

classes.name: ProgressRecord
classes.invariant: levelId belongs to gameId when present.
classes.summary: The best result of a game or a level.

classes.name: SaveProgressResult
classes.summary: The result of a finished game and whether it became the new best.

classes.name: DownloadedLevel
classes.summary: A level definition from the API: its header and the raw document in the API level format.

classes.name: LeaderboardEntry
classes.summary: One row of a leaderboard.

classes.name: UserId
classes.summary: The stable id of a user in the backend.

classes.name: Credentials
classes.summary: Email and password to register or sign in.

classes.name: Email
classes.invariant: one @ and a dot in the domain.
classes.summary: An email address.

classes.name: Password
classes.summary: A password; never logged, never stored on the device.

classes.name: AuthSession
classes.summary: A signed-in session: the user and the access token.

classes.name: AccessToken
classes.summary: The JWT the API issued.

classes.name: Preferences
classes.summary: Sound and language preferences.

classes.name: LanguageCode
classes.summary: An app language.

classes.name: GameSessionAdapter
classes.summary: Adapts a typed GameEngine to the untyped PlayableSession: translates intents into moves, presents states as views, streams an update after each change with one SessionEffect per event (its kind and cells, never its class), and saves through an optional codec. outcome() adds the elapsed time from capabilities.timer when the game has one. Written once for every variant.

classes.name: IIntentTranslator
classes.summary: Turns a neutral intent into a variant move, or null when the intent means nothing in this variant.

classes.name: ISessionPresenter
classes.summary: Turns a variant state into the neutral view of the game screen.

classes.name: IStateCodec
classes.summary: Encodes a whole state, generator state included, as a saved-game payload and back.

classes.name: LevelDto
classes.summary: A level document in the API level format, as read from an asset or the API. Primitives only.

classes.name: ILevelDtoSource
classes.summary: Where variant modules read the document of one level. Declared in layer 3, where the level mappers use it.

classes.name: LocalLevelRepository
classes.summary: Bundled level assets plus downloaded definitions stored in SQLite; the higher version wins.

classes.name: LevelHeaderMapper
classes.summary: LevelDto ⇄ LevelHeader and DownloadedLevel.

classes.name: IAssetReader
classes.summary: Reads a bundled text asset. Declared in layer 3; the Flutter app implements it, so this package does not import Flutter.

classes.name: SqliteProgressRepository
classes.summary: Progress in SQLite.

classes.name: SqliteSavedGameRepository
classes.summary: Saved games in SQLite.

classes.name: SqlitePreferencesRepository
classes.summary: Preferences in SQLite.

classes.name: SecureSessionStore
classes.summary: The signed-in session in the platform's secure storage.

classes.name: ProgressMapper
classes.summary: ProgressRecord ⇄ ProgressDto (rows and API bodies).

classes.name: ProgressDto
classes.summary: Progress with primitives, as stored and sent.

classes.name: HttpProgressGateway
classes.summary: Progress API over HTTP.

classes.name: HttpLeaderboardGateway
classes.summary: Leaderboard API over HTTP.

classes.name: LeaderboardMapper
classes.summary: LeaderboardEntryDto → LeaderboardEntry.

classes.name: LeaderboardEntryDto
classes.summary: A leaderboard row as the API sends it.

classes.name: HttpAccountGateway
classes.summary: Account API over HTTP.

classes.name: HttpLevelGateway
classes.summary: Level API over HTTP.

classes.name: SystemClock
classes.summary: The device clock, in UTC.

classes.name: SecureSeedSource
classes.summary: New seeds from dart:math Random.secure.

classes.name: SoundCueMap
classes.summary: Which sound each event kind plays; unknown kinds play nothing. CompositionRoot builds it with the entries of every variant (one with() line per entry), so a variant names its sounds there.

classes.name: SoundCue
classes.summary: A sound asset.

classes.name: HomeViewModel
classes.summary: The game selector: one card per registered module.

classes.name: LevelSelectViewModel
classes.summary: Levels of a level-based game with progress and locks.

classes.name: GameViewModel
classes.summary: The game screen state for any variant: the view, which buttons to show from the CapabilitySet, the timer, and whether to hide the board while paused (FIT-6). Forwards intents to the use cases.

classes.name: ResultViewModel
classes.summary: Victory or defeat screen: result, new best, retry.

classes.name: LeaderboardViewModel
classes.summary: A leaderboard table.

classes.name: SettingsViewModel
classes.summary: Sound and language settings.

classes.name: AccountViewModel
classes.summary: Register, sign in, sign out, sync.

classes.name: HexaLinesModule
classes.summary: The Hexa Lines module: registers its game id and texts, builds HexaLinesFactory per game, assembles the engine (with the progress model the factory creates) and wraps it in a GameSessionAdapter. Also resumes saved games.

classes.name: LinesIntentTranslator
classes.summary: Hexa Lines: DropPiece → LinesMove (slot from the piece ref); other intents mean nothing.

classes.name: LinesPresenter
classes.summary: Hexa Lines: board colors, the three tray pieces, score and streak.

classes.name: LinesCatalogMapper
classes.summary: Reads the fixed Hexa Lines piece catalog from its configuration asset.

classes.name: LinesStateMapper
classes.summary: LinesState ⇄ saved-game payload (JSON with primitives, generator state included). decode rebuilds the board in the injected topology and the piece source from the catalog and a source restored with the saved generator state.

classes.name: HexaFitModule
classes.summary: The Hexa Fit module: registers its game id and texts, builds HexaFitFactory per game, assembles the engine (with the progress model the factory creates) and wraps it in a GameSessionAdapter.

classes.name: FitIntentTranslator
classes.summary: Hexa Fit: DropPiece → PlaceFitPiece; LiftPiece → RemoveFitPiece of the piece at that cell; RotatePiece → RotateFitPiece by one step.

classes.name: FitPresenter
classes.summary: Hexa Fit: covered cells by piece, the free pieces in their orientation, moves; time comes from the timer capability.

classes.name: FitLevelMapper
classes.summary: LevelDto → FitLevel through a new FitLevelBuilder per level, so every check of the format runs, the registered-topology check included. It passes board.topology as a TopologyId; a name TopologyId refuses becomes InvalidLevelError (board.topology).

classes.name: HexaSortModule
classes.summary: The Hexa Sort module: registers its game id and texts, builds HexaSortFactory per game, assembles the engine (with the progress model the factory creates) and wraps it in a GameSessionAdapter.

classes.name: SortIntentTranslator
classes.summary: Hexa Sort: TapCell → SortMove; other intents mean nothing.

classes.name: SortPresenter
classes.summary: Hexa Sort: the stacks as fills bottom to top, the offered stack, goals and moves.

classes.name: SortLevelMapper
classes.summary: LevelDto → SortLevel through a new SortLevelBuilder per level, so every check of the format runs, the registered-topology check included. It passes board.topology as a TopologyId; a name TopologyId refuses becomes InvalidLevelError (board.topology). Sort levels use only the regular shape.

classes.name: HexaMergeModule
classes.summary: The Hexa Merge module: registers its game id and texts, builds HexaMergeFactory per game, assembles the engine (with the progress model the factory creates) and wraps it in a GameSessionAdapter. Also resumes saved games.

classes.name: MergeIntentTranslator
classes.summary: Hexa Merge: Swipe → MergeMove; other intents mean nothing.

classes.name: MergePresenter
classes.summary: Hexa Merge: tile values as labels and fills, the score, the target notice.

classes.name: MergeStateMapper
classes.summary: MergeState ⇄ saved-game payload (generator state included). decode rebuilds the board in the injected topology and the tile source from the spawn odds and a source restored with the saved generator state.

classes.name: GameScreen
classes.summary: The one game screen for every variant. Draws the SessionView with the board renderer and the painter registered for the game id, animates the cells of each SessionEffect, turns gestures into PlayerIntents, shows undo, redo and the timer from the view model. Never names a variant. Strategy context of IBoardRenderer and ICellPainter.

classes.name: IBoardRenderer
classes.summary: Draws a board view and maps screen positions and gestures back to cells and directions. One per topology.

classes.name: HexBoardRenderer
classes.summary: Renders a hexagonal board with HexLayout.

classes.name: HexLayout
classes.summary: Axial ⇄ pixel conversion for pointy hexagons. Adapted from Red Blob Games, "Hexagonal Grids", https://www.redblobgames.com/grids/hexagons/.

classes.name: ICellPainter
classes.summary: Draws the content of one cell (fills, label) inside the outline the renderer gives. One per variant.

classes.name: CellPainterRegistry
classes.summary: Painters by game id, filled by the composition root.

classes.name: AudioManager
classes.summary: Facade over the audio player: one call plays the cue of an event kind with the current preferences. Implements the IAudioOutput port. One instance, injected.

classes.name: FlutterAssetReader
classes.summary: Reads bundled assets with rootBundle.

classes.name: CompositionRoot
classes.summary: Creates every single instance (topology registry, generator factory, clock, variant registry, audio), registers HexTopology, injects the registry into the level mappers and the topology of their mode into the Lines and Merge modules and their state mappers, which have no level file, picks the board renderer of that same topology, registers the four variant modules and their painters, and wires the services. The only place that names the variants and the topologies.

classes.name: LinesCellPainter
classes.summary: Paints a filled hexagon in the cell color.

classes.name: FitCellPainter
classes.summary: Paints the cell in the color of the piece that covers it, figure cells outlined.

classes.name: SortCellPainter
classes.summary: Paints a stack as layered tiles, bottom to top.

classes.name: MergeCellPainter
classes.summary: Paints a tile with its value and a color per value.
